name: 3D Product Viewer with Three.js
summary: Interactive 3D product viewer CodeComponent using Three.js extension for WebGL rendering. Features Three.PerspectiveCamera, Three.WebGLRenderer with shadow maps, Three.OrbitControls for rotation/zoom, procedural product geometry (BoxGeometry + SphereGeometry + CylinderGeometry), Three.MeshPhysicalMaterial with configurable properties. Controls: material Select (metallic/matte/glass), color RadioGroup with swatches, lighting Slider, screenshot Button. Uses useAppState for material/color/light config, useTheme for scene background synced with platform theme.
shortSummary: 3D product viewer with Three.js, material/color controls, orbit, and screenshot
